name: ai-harness
description: AI Harness 练习项目 - 勤怠・タスク管理

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w apps/web & npm run dev -w apps/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/web && npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w @ai-harness/domain && npm run test -w @ai-harness/infrastructure
scripts.test:watch: npm run test:watch -w apps/web & npm run test:watch -w apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w @ai-harness/domain && npm run typecheck -w @ai-harness/infrastructure
